home.tagline: Your private knowledge base agent. A smart knowledge assistant, one-stop manage all your knowledge.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Open registration is closed. <contact>Contact an admin</contact> for an api-key
login.error: Sign-in failed. Check username or password.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.lead: If the email matches an admin account, a Resend reset link will be sent.
forgot.sent: If that email is registered, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.mailUnavailable: Email service is unavailable. Try again later.
forgot.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.
forgot.error: Could not send the reset link.

reset.title: Set new password
reset.lead: Choose a new password for your admin account.
reset.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

acceptInvite.title: Set password
acceptInvite.lead: Complete your admin account. Open registration stays closed.
acceptInvite.usernameHint: Starts with a letter; letters, digits, and ._- ; 3–64 chars; unique among admins.
acceptInvite.nameInvalid: Name must be English (letters and spaces).
acceptInvite.invalidToken: This invite link is invalid or has expired.
acceptInvite.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.lead: Default seed password detected. Change it before issuing keys or invites. Admins who set a password via invite or reset never see this page.
changePassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

admin.usersLead: One active key per user. MCP and apps share the same key.
admin.nameInvalid: Name must be English (letters and spaces).
admin.revokeConfirmBody: The secret key stops working immediately and leaves this list. Knowledge data is kept, but the user can no longer access it.
admin.issueLead: Create a user and generate an API key. Name is for identification.
admin.issueHint: The full key appears on the next screen; you can open it again from the list later. Each user has an isolated knowledge base.
admin.issuedWarnStrong: Copy and store it securely now.
admin.viewMissingCiphertext: This key has no stored ciphertext. Reissue to enable viewing.
admin.adminsLead: You cannot delete yourself or the last active admin.
admin.inviteLead: They receive a link to set a username, English name, and password. Open registration stays closed.
admin.inviteEmailTaken: An active admin already uses this email.
admin.deleteConfirmBody: They will no longer sign in. User API keys and knowledge are not affected.

guide.title: Integration guide
guide.lead: Private knowledge-base agent. Your personal knowledge assistant—broad coverage, one net, one place. Call it from IDEs and third-party tools via MCP, or from your own apps via REST API.
